metadata.query: Use the search_knowledge_base tool to search for 'What is the computational security status of the AES-256 encryption standard against brute-force attacks?'. Do NOT answer from memory — you MUST call the tool first.

final_answer: The AES-256 encryption standard is considered secure against brute-force attacks for a very long time, even with the most powerful computers currently available. (Source: NIST Special Publication 800-38A Revision 1 (2011))
